name: Vesperal-Obelisk
description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in bioluminescent seas. Travelers navigate by tectonic rift valleys and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.

The air carries dust and something faintly floral, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts. Ambush predators lie beneath the thermally warm silt, patient as geology.
Geologists argue about the strata here: several layers appear deposited out of order, as if the planet's history were shuffled like cards.
There is money in rare flora, geothermal energy and iron and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
